lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Shanice Koehler is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Shanice is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Shanice Koehler is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Shanice kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Shanice's gone." Aki looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Shanice." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Worlasi blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Draw Fire (Level 1). In the wilds, beside your people, you make yourself the problem. Shout, wave, bleed loudly — the beast's eye stays on you and off them. Monsters focus you instead of your allies.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Shanice Koehler, 41 days. The mantle passes to Worlasi Zormelo.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Worlasi Zormelo, 41 — a barber. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Echo Location, War Cry, Dowsing.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Shanice — and Shanice is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Wyatt, Imani, Daniel and 5 more speak for Worlasi — "Shanice trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Worlasi before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 1). You know where fish hold: seams, eddies, shade lines. The water stops being a surface and starts being a map.
